v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
text.en: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

text.la: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

text.la: Lætábitur iustus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
text.en: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

text.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Caríssimi: Communicántes Christi passiónibus gaudéte, ut et in revelatióne glóriæ eius gaudeátis exsultántes.
text.en: Dearly beloved brethren, rejoice, inasmuch as you are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when His glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

r.la: Et ossa eórum púllulent de loco suo.
r.en: And let their bones flourish again out of their place.

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum, habitáre fratres in unum.
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity.

text.la: Dómine Iesu Christe, qui ad recoléndam memóriam dolórum sanctíssimæ Genetrícis tuæ, per septem beátos Patres nova Servórum eius família Ecclésiam tuam fecundásti: concéde propítius; ita nos eórum consociári flétibus, ut perfruámur et gáudiis.
text.en: Lord Jesus Christ, who, that thou mightest recall to mind the woes of thy most holy Mother, didst through the Seven blessed Fathers make thy Church herself the mother of a new household of her servants, grant unto us in mercy that we may so share their tears as to share their blessedness also.

office.title: Ss. Septem Fundatorum Ordinis Servorum B. M. V.
